method: Interleaved paired runs of two executables on one pinned CPU (--pair), 120 samples per side for fib and 60 for the other workloads; CPU time is wait4 ru_utime+ru_stime; A is the 40ae868 (pre-override) runtime and B is the runtime under test. Builds use the same compiler binary with only the runtime sidecars swapped, so the difference is the runtime change alone.
